name: Isshiki Rina
source: One of Chinatsu’s friends. Does not talk much, but is very observant and tends to make pointed comments when she does speak. She is more than happy to use her looks and perception to her advantage, but she is fundamentally sympathetic and helpful toward her friends. Scary to ignore, as she’ll have the whole room wrapped around her pinky before you know it.
